# `toolu sandbox`

Run builds, gates and agent CLIs in a Linux sandbox: a Lima VM on macOS, this machine on Linux.

Owner: `plugins/sandbox`.

## `toolu sandbox`

```text
Run builds, gates and agent CLIs in a Linux sandbox: a Lima VM on macOS, this machine on Linux

Usage: toolu sandbox [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  setup   Create and provision the sandbox, then print how to install and log in to the agent CLIs
  status  Show the backend, the sandbox's state, its settings and this project
  start   Start the sandbox, applying its settings and this project's mounts
  stop    Stop the sandbox
  delete  Delete the sandbox with its disk, caches and agent CLI logins
  run     Run a command in the sandbox at this directory; the exit status is the command's
  shell   Open a login shell in the sandbox at this directory
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json              Print exactly one JSON document on stdout
  -q, --quiet             Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --host <HOST>       The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, cursor, hermes, muse, opencode]
      --config-dir <DIR>  Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
  -h, --help              Print help
```

```text
Run a command in the sandbox at this directory; the exit status is the command's

Usage: toolu sandbox run [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>...

Arguments:
  <COMMAND>...  The command and its arguments

Options:
      --clone             Run in a clone of this checkout on the sandbox's own disk, with its uncommitted and untracked changes
```
